scope_note.zh: 只看 2026/27 欧洲五大联赛男子一线队里的中国、日本、韩国球员。名册沿用 2026-09-08 的日韩一线队注册快照，另补入已出现在法甲与欧塞尔一线队名单中的魏祥鑫。杯赛、欧战、国家队和青训/梯队不计入角色。
scope_note.en: Men's first-team players from China, Japan and Korea in the 2026/27 Big Five. Japan and Korea follow the 8 September 2026 registration snapshot; Wei Xiangxin is added from the Ligue 1 and Auxerre first-team lists. Cups, Europe, national teams and youth or reserve sides are excluded from the role grade.

methodology.zh: 占比 = 国内联赛分钟 /（统计窗口内俱乐部已赛场次 × 90）。核心 ≥75%，主力 ≥50% 且低于 75%，轮换 ≥25% 且低于 50%，替补为已经出场但低于 25%，边缘为联赛 0 分钟。没有核到联赛分钟的记为待核，不按身价、国家队地位或媒体评价补档。各人截止日期不同，因为来源更新日不同。
methodology.en: Share = domestic-league minutes / (club matches played inside the source window × 90). Core is at least 75%, starter at least 50% and below 75%, rotation at least 25% and below 50%, substitute is any appearance below 25%, and fringe is zero league minutes. Missing league minutes stay unrated; market value, national-team status and press labels are not used as substitutes. Each player keeps the date of the source window.
